title: Courtesy History Schedule: Earlier Courtesy Reships and the Bridge Quantity
content:
**Schedule.** On the Blood Glucose Testing Supply Program, the strips a courtesy reship carries for its covered days and its transit days are multiplied by the repeat share, which is 0.75 when the program had a courtesy reship more than 12 and at most 24 calendar months ago, 0.9 when its latest earlier courtesy reship was more than 24 and at most 36 months ago, and 1 otherwise; a reship counts as within N months when its ship date is later than the same calendar day N months earlier.

A courtesy reship here is a replacement shipment of the program with the reason delivered but not received.

| Earlier courtesy reships of the program | Repeat share |
|---|---|
| one more than 12 and at most 24 calendar months ago | 0.75 |
| none in that span, one more than 24 and at most 36 calendar months ago | 0.9 |
| none more than 12 and at most 36 months ago | 1 |

**Boundaries (hypothetical: today is 1 June)**

- A courtesy reship shipped 2 June two years ago is within 24 months and more than 12 months ago: 0.75. One shipped 1 June two years ago is not within 24 months; if it is within 36 months, the share is 0.9.
- A courtesy reship shipped 1 June three years ago is not within 36 months: 1.

**Example.** Strips for the covered and transit days of 80.0 at a repeat share of 0.75 become 60.0.
